rules.rationale: Expands the named digitsCond proof term into the translated AST expression for n > 0.
Expands the named digitsLoopBody proof term into the exact translated statement sequence used by the loop.
Defines SolutionProgram as the closed constructor term for the translated digits implementation.
Observes structural identity of two program terms and emits ProgramsMatch for the launcher check; it is not an additional mathematical fact.
Defines the even-digit case of addOddDigit, leaving the accumulated product unchanged.
Defines the first-odd-digit case of addOddDigit when the zero sentinel is still present.
Defines the subsequent-odd-digit case of addOddDigit by multiplying the accumulator by the digit.
Defines the base case of the oddProductFrom digit-fold recurrence.
Defines the recursive case of oddProductFrom by consuming one base-10 digit and updating the accumulator.
Defines oddProduct as oddProductFrom initialized with the zero sentinel.
Defines the base case of finalScratchDigit, preserving the current scratch value when no digits remain.
Defines the recursive case of finalScratchDigit by tracking the digit written during each remaining loop iteration.
